segments.text: Do we know why the billing dashboard dropped by 84 points?

segments.speaker: Isha Verma
segments.text: I think 73 of the issues come from the same root cause.

segments.speaker: Vikram Joshi
segments.text: The billing dashboard is slower than planned, we lost about 76 hours to rework.

segments.speaker: Rohan Kapoor
segments.text: I see it differently, the billing dashboard needs at least 67 more test runs.

segments.speaker: Shalini Menon
segments.text: Maybe, but 37 of those 97 complaints are duplicates.

segments.speaker: Farhan Qureshi
segments.text: Should we buy a tool for the billing dashboard? I saw one for 45 thousand.

segments.speaker: Rohan Kapoor
segments.text: I would rather not spend 30 thousand on the billing dashboard this quarter.

segments.speaker: Rohan Kapoor
segments.text: Okay, that is all for today. Thanks everyone for staying the whole time.
